improvements: Provide a blank suspect worksheet with time, clock source and display-description columns, and a large shared timeline so a host can still listen.
Explain innocent inaccurate statements through credible mistaken recollection, concealment or observation, rather than requiring many unexplained impossible entries.
Vary testimony phrasing without removing the necessary clock and feature facts.

simulationlimitations: This was an asynchronous scripted read, not a real human party test. I viewed all three authorized images and saved each stage judgment before reading the next. I could retain exact wording and compare structured evidence without interruptions; an actual host must announce stages, manage questions and keep social momentum. I cannot measure laughter, speaking duration, overhearing, player improvisation or whether busy guests remember names and timestamps. My final deduction benefited from deliberate comparison that a host may not have time to make.
